_comment: Configuration-driven quadrant map for sEEGplan. bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] in reference pixel space (referenceWidth x referenceHeight), measured against the actual brain-template.png outline. anteriorAtStart=true means fx=0 (left edge of bbox) corresponds to the anterior/frontal pole; set false to flip. Auto-placement subdivides each bbox into a generic Anterior/Middle/Posterior x Superior/Middle/Inferior grid -- it is an approximation for fast first-pass placement only and is not a substitute for verified neuroanatomy. Always confirm/adjust placed markers against the template before clinical use.
